# Team News: Sage hints at possible Sarr & Nketiah returns

## First-team

Pierre Sage says Ismaïla Sarr and Eddie Nketiah could both return to the matchday squad for Crystal Palace’s first-ever UEFA Europa League fixture on Thursday. [...] Sage said of Sarr: “He could be in the team tomorrow, as [could] Eddie Nketiah, because they started to train with us this week, and they are in shape.”

Asked further about Jean-Philippe Mateta and Dean Henderson – the former missing since the opening day of the season, the latter also absent from last week’s matches, Sage said of the duo’s returns: “I hope it will be after the international break.

“With long injuries, there’s more or less days. That’s why we hope and we will see.” [...] Although he will be absent on Thursday, it was announced just before the press conference that Henderson has signed a new contract with the club, committing his future to Palace until 2030.

Sage smiled: “We are really happy for us, we are really happy for him – it’s a long-term contract for our captain.

results.title: Report: Eagles ease past Poznan in excellent Europa debut
results.content:
On their way... to Frankfurt? A lot of football to be played before then, for sure, but an early indicator of Palace's intentions in this competition.

On the evidence of this performance, you wouldn't bet against it.

Palace: Benítez (GK), Ahanor, Richards (Canvot, 73), Disasi, Khalaili (Mingueza, 61), Timber (McNeil, 62), Wharton, Mitchell, Pino, Kamada (Sarr, 74), Strand Larsen (Nketiah, 74).

Subs: Matthews (GK), Benetton (GK), Tomiyasu, Chilwell, Williams, Osorio. [...] In full control, Palace could have added more, Wharton with a low drive wide and Eddie Nketiah – making his return from injury off the bench along with Ismaïla Sarr – screwing a strike wide when played through on goal by Pino.

Poznań had a late chance too as Michal Gurgul hit a firm first-time drive which Benítez did brilliantly to beat away, low to his left. [...] Report: Eagles ease past Poznan in excellent Europa debut

# Sage targets ‘historic’ Europa League campaign

## Video

Crystal Palace can make history in Europe for a second season in a row, Pierre Sage firmly believes.

 Read the Manager's pre-match team news update. [...] “Ishak is someone who everybody knows,” Sage confirmed. “He scored a lot of goals last year. He competed with Ismaïla Sarr in the Conference League and now he's ready.

“That's why tomorrow we have to be careful with him, and we have to consider him, but we have to consider all the team, because they play well.

“And like I told you, we have to be really focused on what we have to do, first of all, because we have a gap between what we want to do and what we’ve done at the moment. [...] Poznań last season were also in the Conference League, reaching the Round of 16 before falling to Shakhtar Donestk – who Palace went on to eliminate in the last four.

Nevertheless, Sweden international forward Mikael Ishak managed to plunder an impressive eight goals in 10 appearances in Europe last season, only falling one short of the top scorer – Palace’s very own Ismaïla Sarr.

# Dean Henderson signs new Crystal Palace contract

## Announcement

Crystal Palace are delighted to announce that our European trophy-winning captain Dean Henderson has signed a new contract with the club. [...] From the penalty save that kept us in front against Manchester City in May 2025’s FA Cup Final, to the many stops against Liverpool to win the Community Shield at Wembley months later, to wearing the armband throughout the UEFA Conference League knockout stages last season en route to glory in Leipzig, Henderson’s contributions to Palace’s golden era have earned him his place in club folklore.

Now, the 29-year-old has committed the next chapter of his decorated career to the club. [...] Stay tuned for our exclusive Dean Henderson interview – showing from tomorrow (17th September) on Palace TV!
